verdict.rationale: Opting out of AI training is a fair privacy question for an AI video SaaS like Synthesia, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers training-data opt-out, data-use policies or privacy controls. The voice-cloning 'consent and safety controls' mention concerns consent for voice creation, which is an adjacent feature, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
